hook: Beck has spent over 17 years inside Daimler's IT organisation, running IT for Daimler Trucks Asia and Mitsubishi Fuso from Tokyo before becoming CIO of Daimler Truck North America in 2018, where he also now heads IT for autonomous driving. He speaks German, English, French, and Spanish.
name: Lutz Beck

timeline.impact: Heads ERP/SAP template implementation across Asia Pacific and Africa for Daimler entities, based in Singapore
Leads program management for a common European sales application reengineering and SAP template rollout across eleven countries
Heads IT management for wholesale sales Europe and commercial vehicle ordering

timeline.event: Executive Director, IT Management, Daimler AG
timeline.impact: Runs IT finance, controlling, procurement and business intelligence; serves on boards of Daimler Group Services in Madrid and the Philippines
Serves over six years as CIO for Daimler Trucks Asia and Mitsubishi Fuso Truck & Bus Corporation, based in Tokyo
Leads IT for Daimler Truck North America and heads IT for autonomous driving, based in Portland, Oregon

quick_facts: CIO of Daimler Truck North America since 2018, also heading IT for autonomous driving
Previously CIO of Daimler Trucks Asia and Mitsubishi Fuso Truck & Bus Corporation for over six years in Tokyo
Speaks German, English, French and Spanish
Has spent more than 20 years across IT leadership roles inside the Daimler group

achievements.title: CIO, Daimler Truck North America, 2018-present
achievements.impact: Leads IT for Daimler Truck North America, including IT for autonomous driving, for over eight years.

achievements.title: CIO, Daimler Trucks Asia, 2012-2018
achievements.impact: Ran IT for Daimler Trucks Asia and Mitsubishi Fuso Truck & Bus Corporation from Tokyo for over six years.

achievements.title: Executive Director, IT Management, Daimler AG, 2008-2012
achievements.impact: Led IT finance, controlling, procurement and business intelligence, and served on two regional Daimler Group Services boards.
